envelope.description: A failure outside a task's runtime fails that task, not the walk

body.title: A failure outside a task's runtime fails that task, not the walk
body.summary: The plan walk turns an error raised while it handles one task outside the task's runtime (writing the task's record, reporting its progress) into that task's failure and goes on. An error it cannot tie to a task still propagates.
acceptanceChecks: A failure to write one task's record fails that task with the error's message, the plan's result holds the failure, and the tasks after it run
An error that is not tied to a task propagates out of the walk

tests.name: a writing failure while the walk handles one task fails that task and the walk goes on; an error not tied to a task propagates
